sources.title: YYLO readme
sources.locator: What YYLO owns; Stable and prerelease channels; Beginner agent workflow; Typed task and merge flow; Simple or Advanced
sources.finding: YYLO owns coding-agent invocation, workflow/validation receipts and deterministic task/merge gates. Ledger is a separately installed canonical Record/task store. Simple mode shares a checkout; Advanced mode uses controller and task worktrees. Task implementation is external to the deterministic delivery commands.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/services/README.md
sources.locator: Available services: codex.py, claude.py, gemini.py and pi.py
sources.finding: The shipped service scripts wrap named coding CLIs. The README contains some older default examples, so executable launch/default claims are taken from the pinned implementation rather than those examples.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/services/claude.py
sources.locator: ClaudeService; check_claude_installed; command construction and subprocess invocation
sources.finding: The Claude service resolves and invokes the Claude coding CLI, with prompt, permission and tool arguments.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/services/codex.py
sources.finding: The Codex service constructs a codex --cd command with exec/prompt and JSON streaming options and runs that actual coding harness.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/services/gemini.py
sources.finding: The Gemini service invokes the gemini coding CLI and explicitly refuses a headless run without GEMINI_API_KEY.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/services/pi.py
sources.locator: check Pi executable; command construction cmd=[pi]; model alias and output-format separation
sources.finding: The Pi service invokes the pi coding agent. Provider/model aliases such as openai-codex models and Claude output prettifiers do not imply launches of Codex or Claude CLIs through this Pi route.

sources.title: YYLO src/templates/wiki/controller/parallel_runner_and_spec_review.md
sources.locator: Workflow ownership; Managed launcher boundary; Reviewer launcher identity
sources.finding: The shipped controller instructions distinguish generic ordered workflows, a terminal orchestrator, managed worker/reviewer launch scripts and deterministic task/merge commands. Root/reviewer roles are an installed project workflow rather than an autonomous implementation model hidden in task delivery.

sources.title: YYLO src/core/invocation-telemetry.ts
sources.finding: The invocation component writes private local event JSON under the project-state telemetry/events directory, using the event UUID as the filename, mode0600 files, mode0700 directories and exclusive hard-link publication. This narrow local writer does not establish the absence of other vendor telemetry.
